Removes statistics that are older than a specified age.
This frees space in the statistics file, but does not reduce the
size of the file.

Deprecated
This action has been deprecated in current versions of AMPS
and will no longer vacuum statistics. 60East recommends
offline maintenance of the statistics database instead.
See the section on AMPS Statistics, in the AMPS User Guide,
for details on shrinking the size of a statistics database.
